name: swaydeck-bridge
description: Bridge your local SwayDeck PC agent to VS Code: see the detected workspace on your phone and run the project from the deck.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace SwayDeck Bridge still connects to the local agent and reports the workspace (name, path, type, trust state), but it refuses to run anything: "Run project" returns "This workspace is not trusted. Trust it in VS Code first." No command, terminal or static server is started until you trust the workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: SwayDeck Bridge inspects the workspace root on disk (package.json, main.py, index.html) and runs the project in a terminal whose working directory is the real workspace folder. Virtual workspaces do not provide a real folder on disk.

swaydeck.agentUrl.markdownDescription: WebSocket URL of the local SwayDeck PC agent. Only `ws://` URLs on `127.0.0.1` or `localhost` are accepted.
